solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Biblical book provides joy to a clergyman

indicators.note: 'to' says the joy is added on to the clergyman, so it follows him

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is the title of a clergyman
elation is great joy

explanation.surface: A book of the Bible brings delight to a vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: The final book of the New Testament is the Book of Revelation, the apocalypse attributed to John.

clue.text: Some currency back in circulation

parts.note: reads like money returning to use, but currency is a current of water, and some of it flows back in a swirl

explanation.surface: Old banknotes are being used again.
explanation.walkthrough: Currency suggests money; read it as current, water that circles back against the stream.
explanation.definitionFit: An eddy is a small whirl of water or air running against the main current.

clue.text: Show how Venice has developed

indicators.note: a thing that has developed has changed form, so the city's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A demonstration of how the Italian city has grown.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a feeling is to reveal or display it plainly.

clue.text: A huge pain for David's wife

parts.note: big means large, huge
an ail is an old word for an ailment or pain

explanation.surface: A great torment for a man's spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: David is the biblical king; one of his wives was Abigail.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Abigail married King David after her first husband Nabal died.

clue.text: Jot down the first nine letters

indicators.note: in a down clue the word down tells the solver to read the phrase from the bottom up

parts.note: the first nine letters of the alphabet run from A to I

explanation.surface: Write out the opening part of the alphabet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down' reads as writing something down; it is the reversal of A TO I.
explanation.definitionFit: Not one jot means not the smallest amount, the same as not an iota.

clue.text: Dash up and give a number attention

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: to dash is to run
to sing is to perform a number, a song

explanation.surface: Hurry upstairs and give a numbered patient some care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' hints at counting but is a song; 'up' turns RUN into NUR.
explanation.definitionFit: Nursing is care given to the sick, the medical attention a patient receives.

clue.text: Triad thugs running wild

indicators.note: thugs running wild are out of control, so the letters are scattered

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Chinese gangsters on the rampage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone distraught is frantic with worry, beside themselves or wild with grief.

clue.text: Behind gets a smack — you'll be aware of it later

definitions.text: you'll be aware of it later

parts.note: after means behind, following on
a smack is a slight taste or flavour, as in a smack of garlic

explanation.surface: Someone is spanked and will feel it later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Behind' and 'smack' suggest a spanking, but smack means flavour here.
explanation.definitionFit: The flavour that lingers in the mouth after eating or drinking is noticed after the event.

clue.text: Not a serious quarrel though it turns very noisy

indicators.note: 'turns' says the little word it is read backwards before the rest follows

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A minor spat that nonetheless becomes a shouting match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' makes TI from IT; FF is the musical abbreviation for fortissimo.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty falling-out, a slight argument rather than a grave dispute.

clue.text: Manage to give a little publicity to the head of department

indicators.note: 'to' says the publicity is given to the department head, placing it before him

parts.note: ad, a shortened advertisement, is a little piece of publicity
a minister heads a government department

explanation.surface: An instruction to run things by getting the department chief some press coverage.
explanation.definitionFit: To administer a business or estate is to run or oversee it, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Resolve to pay one's debts

definitions.meaning: to resolve a matter or dispute is to ... it, decide it finally
to ... up or ... a bill is to pay what is owed

explanation.surface: Determined to clear what one owes.
explanation.definitionFit: Settle covers both deciding an issue once and for all and paying off an account owed.

clue.text: Undercooked morsel that's eaten

parts.note: rare meat, a steak say, is lightly or under cooked
a bit is a small piece, a morsel

explanation.surface: A bloody little scrap of food that someone swallows.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: Welsh rarebit, cheese on toast, is simply something that is eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Rarebit, melted cheese on toast, is a dish, so it is food that gets eaten.

clue.text: Balances books without profit

definitions.meaning: balances are what is left over, the amounts outstanding
unsold stock that publishers sell off cheaply, at no profit

explanation.surface: Accounts are squared up in ledgers showing no gain.
explanation.definitionFit: Remainders are leftovers or residues, and also surplus books sold off at reduced prices.

clue.text: Insects are developing immunity

indicators.note: something developing is changing shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Bugs are building up protection against pesticides.
explanation.definitionFit: Resistance is the ability of an organism to withstand disease or a poison, a form of immunity.

clue.text: Sorts letters, perhaps

definitions.meaning: printing ... are the metal blocks bearing letters

explanation.surface: Arranges the post into piles, maybe.
explanation.definitionFit: Types are kinds or categories, and type is the printed characters or the blocks that print them.

clue.text: In and out of work — it's not right

parts.note: taken as written
ex is Latin for out of, as in ex-directory
an act is a deed, a piece of work

explanation.surface: Someone forever drifting in and out of jobs is told that this is wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inexact is imprecise, not quite correct or accurate.

clue.text: Spilled a pint, being clumsy

indicators.note: a spilled drink is thrown out of its proper place, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Knocked a beer over, being awkward.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means unsuitable or lacking skill, and so awkward or clumsy.

clue.text: Is prone to untruth?

definitions.meaning: prone means stretched out flat, recumbent

explanation.surface: Does somebody tend to fib?
explanation.definitionFit: Lying means both lying down flat and telling falsehoods, a word with two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Assemble in the mother ship

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
SS, steam ship, prefixes ship names

explanation.surface: Gather together aboard the mother ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mother ship' reads as one vessel, but the two words give separate pieces, and 'in the' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To mass is to gather together in large numbers, as troops mass at a border.

clue.text: They may be inflated, say, and very large

parts.note: eg, for example, means say
OS, outsize, is the clothing size for very large

explanation.surface: Things that can be blown up, for instance, and huge.
explanation.definitionFit: People's opinions of themselves can swell up, so an inflated self-image is a common phrase.

clue.text: For leaks get to know Private Secretary

parts.note: to see is to find out or learn, as in 'I'll see what happened'
PS is the standard abbreviation for a Private Secretary

explanation.surface: To find out about leaks, ask the minister's Private Secretary.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeps, as a verb, means trickles or oozes out slowly, as liquid leaks through a crack.

clue.text: Kind of comedian to fail to keep a date?

definitions.meaning: a comic who performs solo in front of a live audience
to leave a date waiting by not turning up

explanation.surface: Is a certain comic the sort to miss a romantic meeting?
explanation.definitionFit: Stand-up comedy is solo live comedy, and to stand someone up is to miss a date with them.

clue.text: Arab leaders give one the shivers, by the sound of it

indicators.note: 'by the sound of it' says the solver should go by how the words are spoken

parts.note: something that shakes one makes one tremble, gives one the shivers

explanation.surface: Desert chieftains seem to frighten people.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheikhs are chiefs or heads of Arab tribes, families or villages.

clue.text: Is set in this month's presses

indicators.note: 'set in' says the word is gets placed inside the next piece

parts.note: inst, short for instant, means this month in old business letters, here with its 's
taken as written

explanation.surface: A line about something being laid into this month's printing machines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set in' puts IS inside INST'S, the old commercial abbreviation 'inst' (this month) plus its S.
explanation.definitionFit: Insists, as a verb, means urges or presses a point firmly.

clue.text: It gets down to sorting the list

indicators.note: sorting the words means rearranging their letters into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone settles down to the task of putting a list in order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets down' reads as settling to a task, but down here is fluff.
explanation.definitionFit: Thistles produce thistledown, the fluffy seed heads, so the plant literally grows down.

clue.text: Good pubs re-built

indicators.note: the letters are built up again in a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Nice bars that have been reconstructed.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 're-built' splits: RE joins PUBS as fodder and 'built' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb means excellent, very good indeed.

clue.text: Formidable woman appears to be tedious

definitions.meaning: a fierce, intimidating woman, like a battleaxe
to go on for far too long, as a meeting does when it drags on

explanation.surface: A fearsome lady comes across as boring.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer 4,2 for the second sense: something that drags on is tediously long.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragon is a fierce older woman, and drag on means continue tiresomely.

clue.text: Rise like a lark?

parts.note: sounds like getting up early, as early risers are called larks, but means flying upward as the songbird does

explanation.surface: Get up early in the morning?
explanation.walkthrough: 'like a lark' suggests an early riser; the songbird climbs high into the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: To soar is to fly high into the air, as skylarks do when singing.

clue.text: Block vote?

definitions.meaning: to block a proposal is to forbid or ban it
a ruling by one voter that can stop a measure, a blocking vote

explanation.surface: Voting as a single bloc?
explanation.definitionFit: A veto is the power or act of forbidding a measure, and a vote that blocks it.

clue.text: Porter found gold ring after party

indicators.note: 'after' puts the gold and ring behind the party

parts.note: a do is an informal party
or is gold in heraldry
a keeper is a plain ring that holds another on the finger or keeps a piercing open

explanation.surface: A hotel porter turned up a golden ring after a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter is a doorman, not a carrier or the beer; OR is the heraldic word for gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A porter in the old sense guards a gate or entrance, the person who keeps the door.

clue.text: Sweet kind of music

definitions.meaning: a hard stick of candy sold at British seaside resorts, lettered through
a genre of popular music with loud guitars and drums

explanation.definitionFit: Rock is both a British seaside confectionery stick and a genre of popular music.

clue.text: Small volume of overseas tourism

parts.note: reads like a modest amount of foreign travel, but a volume is a book: a slim guide carried abroad for useful expressions

explanation.surface: Not much holiday traffic abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'volume' tempts as a quantity; it is a book, the pocket guide tourists take abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A pocket guide listing useful sayings in a foreign language is a small book used by travellers.
